description: This file contains functions for IPv4 address manipulation, including validation, conversion between dotted-quad and integer formats, bit counting, subnet calculations, and address type checks (e.g., RFC1918, loopback, multicast). It also defines specific IP address ranges as variables.

methods.name: assert_uint32
methods.description: Validates that input is a decimal number within 0 to 2^32-1.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: str2ip
methods.description: Converts a dotted-quad IP string to a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: ip2str
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer IP to dotted-quad string.

methods.name: prefix2netmask
methods.description: Converts a prefix length to a subnet mask in integer form.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if a subnet mask has contiguous bits.

methods.name: netmask2prefix
methods.description: Converts a subnet mask to prefix length after validation.

methods.name: is_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within RFC1918 private ranges.

methods.name: is_rfc3927
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within RFC3927 link-local range.

methods.name: is_loopback
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: is_multicast
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a multicast address.
